author: _Avy
body:
Hey guys!
We've recently made a destroy the monument map called Calex.
A huge thanks goes out to Captain who hosted the server, YAML and did the world editing that failed on me. Other mentions go out to Zedd who drove me crazy while chilling out on the map, and Cacal who was forced to check it out many times <3

Images: http://imgur.com/a/qXMup
YAML: http://pastebin.com/uwPtHLze
Download: http://pixelraven.net/Calex.zip

About the map:
We went with a "Less is more" design based on simplicity and game play.
There are two teams composed of 25 players, Red Vs Cyan with two monuments on the left and right.
Load out consists of:
-Full leather armour 
-Iron Sword
-Infinity bow
-Diamond Pickaxe
-2 Golden apples
-25 Steak
-32 Oak wood
-Stack of Glass

Features include:
-A building hight limit of 50 blocks (Preventing massive Skybridges) 
-Can only bridge out 10 blocks from the widest point (Preventing U-Bridges) 
-You cannot pick up obsidian to make Op Defences ;D   
-When a monument has been broken the beacons will light up.
-Two crafting tables and "Tool boxes" at each monument for defenders consisting of more wood, axes + stone. 
-Underground shooting area

All comments are appreciated and we hope you enjoy!
Thanks :D

replies.author: _Avy
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback guys! <3 

Will look into the things mentioned Luxe. You can only bridge up 70 blocks from the base of the map and I'll contact DC about U-Bridging. 

@Zedd
It was intentionally designed to be blocky, note what I said in the main post "Less is more" "Based on simplicity and game play." Maps like Rendezvous and Senex are not "Aesthically pleasing" but are wonders when playing. 
The gap can not be too large like the original Senex 2 where it was really hard to make a bridge to the other side. 
I find having middle islands quite annoying ingame and repetitive hence why there's none.
In the future it will be appreciated if you tell us ingame while we are building the map.
